CONFIG:
# BEGIN OPTIONAL HOST MONITOR CONFIG
# Optional host summaries only; never expose the SQLite store or Docker socket.
# Installation and this repository variable are enabled as a separate rollout step.
if [ '${{ vars.HOST_METRICS_ENABLED }}' = 'true' ]; then
  host_exports=/var/snap/docker/common/geupddong-host-monitor/exports
  [ -d "$host_exports" ]
  [ ! -L "$host_exports" ]
  printf '%s\n' 'HOST_METRICS_DIRECTORY=/var/lib/geupddong-host-metrics' >> .env
fi
# END OPTIONAL HOST MONITOR CONFIG
MOUNT:
# BEGIN OPTIONAL HOST MONITOR MOUNT
if [ '${{ vars.HOST_METRICS_ENABLED }}' = 'true' ]; then
  python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('docker-compose.yml')
text = path.read_text()
marker = '    # HOST_MONITOR_READ_ONLY_VOLUME'
assert text.count(marker) == 1
mount = '    volumes:\n      - type: bind\n        source: /var/snap/docker/common/geupddong-host-monitor/exports\n        target: /var/lib/geupddong-host-metrics\n        read_only: true\n        bind:\n          create_host_path: false'
path.write_text(text.replace(marker, mount))
PY
fi
# END OPTIONAL HOST MONITOR MOUNT
